headline: NVS: no trade. Remibrutinib cut MS relapses 31-35% in Phase 3; comparator unknown, no reaction
reasoning: REMODEL-1 and REMODEL-2 met on annualized relapse rate (35.2% and 31.2% reductions).
Novartis was already -3.1% on the day before the release; IEX shows no reaction to it.
Check later: NVS 5-day return; if the comparator turns out to be an active drug and the market reads the effect as weak, a delayed decline would show.
objections: Comparator not disclosed; effect size ambiguous; immaterial at Novartis's size; no reaction.
